name: feature-theater
description: Native Astra feature lanes with isolated clones, durable specs, live steering, executed verification, and an inline work graph.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate feature clones and see their work graph in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adopt a repository or begin a managed project from scratch, then develop it through isolated feature lanes. GPT-6 Astra refines specs, coordinates work, steers live agents, and checkpoints context. A native work graph shows dependencies, progress, and blockers; all interaction stays in the existing conversation. Required checks execute against exact commits and the current feature contract. Feature Theater combines Diffmogger's durable work graph and evidence boundaries with Agent Diff Theater's live steering, entirely inside the Codex harness.
defaultPrompt: Set up Feature Theater for this repository.
Start a managed project from a product brief.
Create a feature lane and refine its spec.
Show this feature's work graph and what is blocked.
